Reverse the route, restore the original bottle position, release, and retreat vertically by 0.12 m.

safety_checks: Use the supplied numeric AABBs and elevations rather than the rounded scene heading.
All TCP targets lie within the 0.32–0.75 m usable base-distance range; the maximum target distance is approximately 0.724 m.
The front detour keeps the loaded transport segments outside the horizontal inner radius; the closest segment approaches approximately 0.322 m.
Maintain at least 0.03 m clearance between the TCP/carried bottle and all non-target AABBs; intended grasp and placement contacts are exceptions.
The carried bottle bottom clears the dosing balance top by 0.1341 m and the ethanol top by 0.1321 m at transport height.
Interpolate motion with Cartesian increments no greater than 0.020 m and orientation deviation no greater than 0.25 rad; maintain tool-down orientation without pouring.
Treat the dosing waypoint's 2 s as a stationary dwell after arrival, not as descent time.
Before execution, validate full-arm inverse kinematics, gripper geometry, swept-volume clearance, and the initial transition; these are not fully specified by the scene AABBs.
